About the line

“I built Loudhaus because the world keeps telling people to quiet down. Be smaller. Don't take up space. I spent years being told who to be — I'm done with that. Loudhaus is clothing for people who refuse to be muted. Every piece has intent behind it. Agency is loud. Wear it like you mean it.”
Loudhaus by MHG Group. — Building today's apps for tomorrow.
